tools.name: company_search
tools.description: Search Companies House by name. Returns company number, status, type, incorporation date, address. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: company_profile
tools.description: Full Companies House profile for a company number: status, SIC codes, registered office, accounts and confirmation statement due dates and overdue flags, charges and insolvency flags. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: company_officers
tools.description: Directors and secretaries for a company number, with appointment and resignation dates. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: company_pscs
tools.description: Persons with significant control (beneficial owners) for a company number. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: company_filings
tools.description: Filing history for a company number (accounts, confirmation statements, officer changes, charges). (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: companies_incorporated
tools.description: Find companies by incorporation date range, SIC codes, status, location or name fragment (Companies House advanced search). New-business lead lists. (cost: 2 credits)

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "company_officers" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
